# Frozen whole strategies (WP2)

Files here are written by the generation sessions (`scripts/generate_strategies.py`) and copied
**verbatim** by the freeze step: `<domain>/s<NN>__v1.py`. Do not edit, format or lint them; their
sha256 and provenance are locked in `../strategies.lock.toml` (D-038). A change needs a new
version file and a recorded decision.
